title: Kozhikode Atlas compact geographic data

datasets.name: Kozhikode district boundary
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 for gbOpen; source metadata reports ODbL 1.0
datasets.processing: Selected shapeName Kozhikode; validated and clipped only at native boundary.
datasets.limitations: Boundary is not a cadastral/legal survey; source metadata lists Pathways Data Pvt. Ltd. and lgdirectory.gov.in.

datasets.name: OSM settlements, roads, rivers, coastline
datasets.resolution: OSM objects in Kozhikode bbox; query recorded in scripts/acquire.py
datasets.processing: Queried nodes/ways, intersected to district polygon, removed exact duplicate geometries, simplified linear features by 35 m in projected EPSG:32643 (UTM 43N), then returned to EPSG:4326 for compact delivery.
datasets.limitations: OSM coverage, tags and positional accuracy vary; this is not authoritative transport or hydrography. Coastline is included only because OSM coastline ways were acquired; no coastline feature was invented.
